title: SDK & API launch checklist: samples, docs, release notes coordination, privacy & demo scenarios
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose:
Create a cross-functional, actionable launch checklist and ownership matrix for the SDK + API surface launch (function calling, structured output, streaming). Deliverables include: release notes draft, sample kit (JS + Python + Go), docs pages, demo scenarios with privacy-appropriate sample data, and a handoff pack for GTM and Customer Success.

Scope:
- Public SDKs (JS, Python, Go) with function calling and streaming examples
- API docs: structured output guide, streaming guide, function calling contract examples
- Release notes: customer-facing summary + internal changelog + migration notes
- Sample kit: reproducible examples, snippet gallery, localized README + code comments
- Demo scenarios: three scripted demos (chat agent, summarizer w/structured output, streaming transcription pipeline) with redactable data templates
- Compliance/Privacy: sample data templates, legal signoff checklist, any KMS notes for Private customers

Success criteria:
- Release notes approved by PM, Eng, and Legal (PR merged)
- Sample kit published in GitHub repo with CI checks and passing tests
- Docs staged and validated in staging docs site with code snippets runnable via Quickstart
- GTM playbook deck and one-pager completed and shared with Sales + CS

Primary owners:
- PM: Liam Chen (launch coordinator)
- Docs: Marisol Ortega (documentation lead)
- SDK: Kevin Park (SDK lead - JS/Python) and Priya Rao (Go SDK)
- Samples: DevRel (Owning sample kit packaging)
- Legal/Privacy: SSO & Compliance (legal-review@redwood.ai)

Key milestones and timeline:
- 2025-09-05: Draft release notes + sample list (DONE)
- 2025-09-10: Internal review w/Docs + SDKs (IN PROGRESS)
- 2025-09-12: Legal & Security review kickoff (IN PROGRESS)
- 2025-09-18: Samples merged to staging repo (BLOCKED by test flakiness)
- 2025-09-22: Docs live on staging + snippet validation (PLANNED)
- 2025-09-30: Public release (target)

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Streaming SDK edge cases cause flaky CI. Mitigation: Add additional integration test harness and isolate flaky scenarios; schedule a 3-day fix window before final freeze. Owner: Kevin Park.
- Risk: Legal review delays on privacy sample templates. Mitigation: Provide minimal, sanitized templates and explicit opt-out notes for customers using production data. Owner: Aisha Patel (PM).
- Risk: Breaking changes for existing API contracts. Mitigation: Provide migration guide snippets and backward-compatible feature flags where possible. Owner: ENG-22134 lead.
